comment: M0 §5.2. Pinned in git: every record and every registry entry carries the commit SHA of this file. Targets are release-manifest ROLES, resolved to addresses from the watcher config.

SLASH.reason: BLS operator slash executed (impossible through DVTValidator in 5.5.0: empty evidence allowlist; so this came by the owner route)

REPUTATION.reason: BLS reputation batch (5.5.0 does no reputation scoring)

QUEUE.reason: operator frozen by a guardian quorum (queueSlashWithConsensus)

expected.reason: BLS price update: threshold is caller-chosen (>= minThreshold); SP caps each update but not a chain of updates

unexpected.reason: generic BLS call outside the expected target/selector set

UNRECOVERED.reason: BLS-executed action whose message could not be authenticated from the transaction

ownerRoute.label: owner/guardian route: not BLS, no on-chain signer verification
ownerRoute.comment: Events from a call into SuperPaymaster whose selector is NOT one of publicRoute.functions (owner, guardian or aggregator-only functions). The caller and selector are recorded when known.

publicRoute.comment: #400 M1 (DSR verdicts 2026-11-10). SuperPaymaster functions ANYONE may call that emit watched events (SP 5.5.1 SuperPaymasterAdmin.sol: updatePrice :507, executeEmergencyPrice :417, pauseUnderstakedOperator :105). An event is classified by the selector and msg.sender of the SP call that emitted it; the caller is recorded and never accused.
publicRoute.label: permissionless call: caller recorded, not accused

updatePrice().alsoReason: price mode changed via permissionless refresh (caller not accused)

executeEmergencyPrice().reason: permissionless execution of an owner-queued emergency price (caller not accused)

pauseUnderstakedOperator(address).reason: permissionless pause of an understaked operator (routine; W3)

unattributed.reason: SuperPaymaster event that a permissionless function can also emit, whose emitting call could not be determined after every retry (not attributed to anyone)
